description: Deep codebase analysis and issue detection

description: Reconcile known_issues status with Jira Cloud cards

name: flow-archive-issue
description: Archive resolved issue to compact format

name: flow-maintain
description: Maintain known_issues.md and prioritization.md

name: flow-close-issue
description: Close remote issue and archive after PR merge

name: flow-check-pr
description: Check PR merge status for issues and auto-archive merged ones

name: flow-review-external
description: Review external branches/MRs with structured report generation

name: flow-bump-version
description: Calculate and apply version bump, update changelog, commit, tag, and publish to main

name: flow-backup
description: Create intelligent timestamped backup excluding junk

name: discovery
description: Refine an idea or existing issue into a canonical, linted local issue. Use for discovery before delivery.

name: flow-aibot-notify
description: Post standardized aibot message to a remote issue

name: flow-import-skill
description: Import external skills as git clones via skill-vendor.sh

name: flow-telegram-notify
description: Send a manual Telegram notification

name: flow-cv-banner
description: Generate a LinkedIn profile banner (4:1) from the candidate hub — art-director direction + each::sense image generation with phone/email/socials and a short phrase, respecting the profile-photo safe zone; outputs under ~/career/<candidate>/linkedin/banner/ (never fabricates, never publishes)

name: flow-linkedin-carousel
description: Generate a LinkedIn carousel deck (1080x1080 slides -> deck.pdf) from a researched topic, running inside the target project: preflight docs/assets/person.json + logo, web research with saved sources, canonical deck.json spec (EN design prompt + user-language text per slide), each::sense art + deterministic Chrome typography/logo when EACHLABS_API_KEY is set, prompts-only fallback otherwise; outputs under docs/carousel/<slug>/; never fabricates identity/content; nothing is published

name: flow-cv-hub
description: Build candidate resume hub (hub.json + README.md) from CV PDF + LinkedIn export

name: flow-cv-hub-update
description: Update an existing candidate hub incrementally (add/update entries without recreating hub.json)

name: flow-cv-tailor
description: Generate job-tailored resume PDF from candidate hub

name: flow-cv-optimize
description: Analyze candidate profile and generate improvement plan (profile-analysis.md + PDF)

name: flow-cv-cover-letter
description: Generate job-tailored cover letter PDF from candidate hub

name: flow-cv-linkedin
description: Generate an objective-driven LinkedIn action report from the candidate hub - literal headline, structured Sobre with metric bullets, per-role experience bullets, and skills add/promote/remove (via cv-linkedin-sync export or pasted list); outputs linkedin-optimization.md in the user language (never scrapes, never fabricates)

name: flow-cv-interview-prep
description: Generate a structured interview preparation kit from candidate hub

name: flow-cv-ats-score
description: Score a generated resume's ATS compatibility (keyword match, sections, format)

name: develop-full
description: Run the full task lifecycle end-to-end for one or more issues: promote, develop, review, QA, MR, auto-merge, return-to-base, close + archive

name: flow-build-ui
description: Orchestrate the 4-pass greenfield design pipeline (art-director → ui-architect → ui-implementer → ui-critic) with deterministic output files

name: flow-audit-ui
description: Orchestrate the audit/refactor pipeline for existing codebases (ui-auditor → ui-refactor-planner, optionally → build pipeline)
